name: "Feature Request"
about: "Suggest an electronic music feature, DSP device, or workflow enhancement for Oxide Studio"
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

### Proposal Summary

A clear and concise description of what feature, synthesizer, effect, or workflow improvement you are proposing.

### Musical / Electronic Production Focus

Which genre or production workflow benefits most from this addition?
- [ ] Techno / Peak-Time / Hardgroove
- [ ] House / Tech House / Deep House
- [ ] Drum & Bass / Jungle
- [ ] RKT / Turreo / Latin Urban
- [ ] Bass Music / Dubstep / Halftime
- [ ] Ambient / IDM / Experimental
- [ ] General DAW Workflow / Cross-Genre

### Problem Statement

What is cumbersome, slow, or missing in current digital audio workstation workflows today?
Describe the producer pain point that this feature aims to solve.

### Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed feature, device, or workflow addition in Oxide Studio:
- How should the producer interact with it in the Session or Arrangement view?
- What are the controllable parameters, routing options, or keyboard shortcuts?
- Does it introduce a new DSP device, GUI component, or MCP copilot tool?

### Technical & Real-Time Constraints

- [ ] Does this run on the hard real-time audio thread? If so, does it guarantee **zero heap allocations** and **zero blocking locks** during `process()`?
- [ ] What are the memory or CPU budget requirements (e.g. pre-allocated wavetables, delay lines)?
- [ ] Are there specific DSP stability or anti-aliasing / oversampling requirements?

### Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches, existing third-party plugins, or hardware workflows you considered.
